name: yizhiwang-zcode-plugins
description: Personal ZCode plugins marketplace: session token/performance stats bar, /stats command and local stats daemon.

description_i18n.en: Personal ZCode plugins marketplace: session token/performance stats bar, /stats command and local stats daemon.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 个人 ZCode 插件市场：会话 token/性能统计悬浮条、/stats 命令与本地统计守护进程。

plugins.name: session-stats
plugins.description: Session token & performance stats bar pinned to the ZCode window bottom, plus a /stats command that renders a detailed stats card in chat. NOTE: the status bar itself requires running install.sh once (asar injection is outside the marketplace mechanism); the marketplace install provides the hooks + /stats command.
